Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候人觉得祭拜非常重要，孟子很小的时候，从早到晚一直祭拜，因为他妈妈告诉他祭拜很重要。虽然他没有朋友，因为每天只祭拜。他的同学们老是对他开玩笑了。孟子妈妈看了他的同学们对孟子不好的影响，所以孟子和孟子妈妈搬家了。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 古代的时候人觉得祭拜非常重要，孟子很小的时候：在古代，人们，“人“ is too general and too vague, and does not stand alone；better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
- 虽然他没有朋友，因为每天只祭拜：delete虽然，there is no “even though” meaning here
- 他的同学们老是对他开玩笑了：跟他开玩笑，no了for routine/habit
- 孟子妈妈看了他的同学们对孟子不好的影响：看到，看look vs.看到see; 有不好的影响
- 所以孟子和孟子妈妈搬家了：delete孟子和孟子妈妈, redundant

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，古代 already expresses a time period, so adding 的时候 redundantly repeats the time meaning. [vocab list]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 人：人们，this sentence refers to people collectively, so 人们 is the appropriate noun. [teacher rule: ren_renmen]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 看了：看到了，the mother is meant to perceive the classmates’ effect on Mengzi; 看 means “look,” while 看到 expresses successfully seeing or noticing something. [vocab list]
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子和孟子妈妈：孟子和妈妈，within the same sentence, do not repeat the name inside the second noun phrase when 妈妈 clearly refers to Mengzi’s mother. [rule: redundancy_delete]
5. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 老是对他开玩笑了：老是对他开玩笑，老是 describes a habitual action, so it takes the zero particle rather than 了. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
6. [Coherence: connectors, error] Coherence (Conjunction): 虽然他没有朋友，因为每天只祭拜：因为他每天只祭拜，所以他没有朋友，this is a cause-and-effect relationship, so use 因为……所以…… rather than 虽然. [rule: coherence_connectives]

items.reason: 古代 already denotes a time period, so 古代的时候 is redundant under the teacher's rule.
人 is too generic for this concrete collective group; 人们 is required by the teacher's rule.
看到 correctly expresses that Mengzi's mother noticed the negative effect, unlike 看了.
The teacher treats the whole repeated subject 孟子和孟子妈妈 as redundant after 孟子妈妈, so changing it to 孟子和妈妈 does not fully make the needed zero-reference correction.
老是 marks a habitual action, so sentence-final 了 should not be used.
This is a cause-and-effect relation, and 因为他每天只祭拜，所以他没有朋友 is a correct restructuring.
